FLIR T650SC Portable Thermal Imaging Camera with 25° lens and ResearchIR Max, 640 × 480
Model: T650SC | Order No: 55904-7823 
 Be the first to review this product
The handheld infrared camera with 25° lens features thermal and visual imagery, 640 x 480 spot size resolution, and reliable temperature measurement accuracy. It has a built-in digital camera, voice annotation, laser target locator, GPS, Multi Spectral Dynamic Imaging (MSX®), UltraMax™ image enhancement, and more. 
The handheld infrared camera with 25° lens features thermal and visual imagery, 640 x 480 spot size resolution, and reliable temperature measurement accuracy. It has a built-in digital camera, voice annotation, laser target locator, GPS, Multi Spectral Dynamic Imaging (MSX®), UltraMax™ image enhancement, and more.
